official_sources.sign_repair_policy: No official later version, erratum, or author correction is frozen. Flipping the Hohl Einstein coefficient or curvature sign is an unsupported semantic mutant and cannot make the candidate eligible.
coverage_only_transcription_caveats: Official lines 4818-4824 print n in terms whose unique free spacetime index is m. For formula-family availability only, the same-source tensorial resolution is n->m exactly as disclosed and frozen in PHASE15A_CONVENTION_MAP.json; no transformation is executed in Phase 15R.

Official lines 4866-4868 contain a malformed dotted parameter in the Kähler-Christoffel term and an unbarred outer species glyph in the conjugate Kähler-weight term. In the frozen one-flat-field specialization Gamma_bar=0 removes the former before transcription, and conjugation fixes the latter outer label k->kbar. A future tangency cycle must preregister these resolutions again before using the formulas.

inherited_convention_authority_for_cover.scope: U1/U2 glyph-resolution provenance only; no invalid Phase 15A result or tangency inference is inherited.

Simplified phenomenological bosonic sign cross-check; it omits four-fermion interactions and is not the full off-shell parent.
Only boson-producing parts of fermion transformations and boson transformations linear in fermions; not full auxiliary-retaining coverage.

literal_bosonic_specialization.metric: The executable derives arbitrary positive lapse from the source's own diffeomorphism-covariant Riemann definition; it does not import Hohl omega or set N=1 before the identity.
literal_bosonic_specialization.matter: Choose the frozen one-field flat-canonical specialization g_i^j=1 and use the source physical scalar phi_source=Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), equivalently z=z_0+M_P^(-1) Z under zepsphi. The same-source gijisgij identity preserves that chosen metric normalization under the z-to-phi coordinate change; it does not itself set the metric to one. Use the choise U(1) gauge nonsingular at W=0, W identically zero, and no vectors or gauging. No additional M_P rescaling of Z is allowed.
literal_bosonic_specialization.expected_known_prior: R_K=-6 Q; L_K,raw=+dot(B)-3 M_P^2 V_0 a dot(a)^2/N; the first-order (X,T,Y) inertia is (1 negative, 2 positive).

official_sources.full_offshell_scope_guard: This source is not eligible for the full-off-shell target because the displayed transformations omit the auxiliary fields and the later phenomenological action/transformations have used auxiliary equations and restricted fermion order. It remains eligible for the independent bosonic sign target.

exact_convention_map.coordinate_time: dot=d/dt; adot, addot, Ndot, Tdot, and Ydot are independent real jet symbols before identities are imposed

exact_coefficient_domains.real_result_domain: QQ(sqrt(2),sqrt(3)) extended by the declared real jet symbols and their allowed rational functions on M_P V_0 a N !=0
exact_coefficient_domains.transcription_extension: QQ(i,sqrt(2),sqrt(3)) with conjugation i->-i, used to state and exactly multiply/reduce the Z and Zbar bridge
exact_coefficient_domains.executable_real_identity: The bosonic executable must either calculate dot(Z)dot(Zbar)=[dot(T)^2+dot(Y)^2]/2 in the transcription extension or perform the exactly equivalent real-pair calculation. In either implementation the comparison record is projected to the real result domain and contains no i.

exact_convention_map.matter_bridge: Z=(T+iY)/sqrt(2), Zbar=(T-iY)/sqrt(2), so dot(Z)dot(Zbar)=[dot(T)^2+dot(Y)^2]/2 on the real slice
exact_convention_map.scale_bridge: X=sqrt(6) M_P ln(a), dX=sqrt(6) M_P da/a, p_X=a p_a/[sqrt(6) M_P]
exact_convention_map.Q_curv: This is the contract shorthand Q: addot/(a N^2)+adot^2/(a^2 N^2)-adot Ndot/(a N^3). The prefix QQ is reserved for exact number fields.
exact_convention_map.dot_B: 3 M_P^2 V_0[2 a adot^2/N+a^2 addot/N-a^2 adot Ndot/N^2]

first_order_policy.guard: No ordinary velocity Hessian is assigned to a raw second-order Lagrangian. After this one registered velocity-dependent endpoint removal, only dF(q,t)/dt with F independent of lapse and velocities is allowed.

exact_convention_map.first_order_template: L_first=V_0 a^3[s_X dot(X)^2+dot(T)^2+dot(Y)^2]/(2N), with s_X in {-1,+1}
exact_convention_map.momenta: p_X=s_X V_0 a^3 dot(X)/N, p_T=V_0 a^3 dot(T)/N, p_Y=V_0 a^3 dot(Y)/N
exact_convention_map.equivalence_domain: Only derivative-free regular real point maps q'=f(q), det(J)!=0, with no lapse or velocity dependence; G transforms by congruence J^T G J. Strictly positive lapse, densitizer, and unit normalization preserve inertia.

source_tagged_derivation_graph.primitive_clone_rule: The contract literals metric, Q_curv, B, X, Z bridge, and positive symbols are specifications, not shared graph nodes. Each branch independently instantiates tagged leaf copies metric_H/Q_H/B_H/X_H/Z_H, metric_K/Q_K/B_K/X_K/Z_K, or metric_A/Q_A/B_A/X_A/Z_A. Identical printed values create no cross-tag graph edge.
source_tagged_derivation_graph.node_rule: Every symbolic derivation node stores exactly one source_tag, and every parent of every symbolic derivation node must have the same tag as the child. There is no mixed-source comparison node inside the symbolic DAG.
source_tagged_derivation_graph.comparison_boundary: Only completed immutable per-tag terminal records may be read by a non-symbolic decision layer outside the derivation DAG. That decision record has no source_tag, cannot be a derivation parent, and may compare only source hashes, R/Q coefficient, raw boundary identity, first-order Hessian, inertia, scalar-sign check, and source-coverage status.
